settings.heading: What you'll receive
settings.content:
The frame itself, posted out to you. On its own it arrives empty — the portrait in the photographs is only there to show the frame in use.

Order it alongside any piece from the custom portrait collection and I will print your portrait for free, fit it into this frame and send the finished thing out ready to stand on a shelf or hang on the wall. You pay for the artwork and the frame; the printing is included.

settings.heading: Delivery & returns
settings.content:
Frames are posted from the UK. Delivery is calculated at checkout and I ship to the UK, Europe and internationally.

You can return a frame within 14 days of receiving it for any reason, and I'll refund you once it's back with me. If it arrives damaged, send me a photograph and I'll replace or refund it in full, postage included.
